contract.tax_note: USD nett, non-commissionable. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes the hotel may add them from the date of implementation.
contract.guide_policy_text: Driver Accommodation – Not Available (no guide accommodation terms printed).
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival.
contract.payment_text: Travel agents without credit facilities are required to make the relevant payment 05 days before the clients check into the hotel. Travel agents that are entitled to credit facilities should make necessary payments within one month of the departure of guests. For last minute/short notice bookings, 100% of the payment is to be made on confirmation.
contract.terms_text: OLIVE BUNGALOW: Single Reduction – USD 20 (On BB), USD 50 (On HB), USD 75 (On FB). Value Additions (Minimum 03 nights & above): Tea Estate Walk; Box of Cookies on arrival; Authentic Sri Lankan High Tea (once per stay). Rates: Deluxe (04 Rooms); Whole Villa (Maximum 08 Pax). Driver Accommodation – Not available. Reservations +94 70 788 1668, resv.villas@jetwinghotels.com. | RATES: Rates are in USD and are non-commissionable. The accommodation rates are not valid for Meetings/Incentives/Conferences/Events/Exhibitions/Weddings. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes, the hotel reserves the right to add such taxes to the rates from the date of implementation. Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets. Rates should not be published as hotel only rate on the internet by you or any other 3rd party. If such case occurs, the hotel has the right to withdraw the rate with immediate effect. | CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT: Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 12:00 (noon). If an early check-in is required within 04 hours of the usual check-in time, 50% charge of the room rate will be applied. For late check-outs up to 04 hours past the original check-out time, a 50% room rate charge will apply. Late check outs past 04 hours will be charged for 100% room rate.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Jetwing Hotels - Select Hotels - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026-2027 (Revised).pdf" (8 pages), saved to the HOTEL RATES folder on 2 Oct 2026. Currency "USD Nett (Per room/Per night)", occupancy "Double Occupancy": the printed figure is the room at double occupancy. Market list: "Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets" → DOM excluded. No contract date, gala dinner or guide rate is printed. No supplier record in the live system yet. The sheet prints "26th December 2026 – 10th January 2026" — year typo, entered as 10 Jan 2027. No triple supplement and no child-with-extra-bed rate is printed. The sheet also prices the Whole Villa (maximum 08 pax) per night BB/HB/FB: 270/510/710, peak 360/600/800, 11 Jan – 31 Mar 290/530/730 — entered in the separate per-unit plan jetwing_olive_bungalow_villa_w2627 (one plan cannot mix per-room and per-unit).
contract.child_policy_text: Child Policy (Maximum Up to 02 Children): Age of 0-5 Free of Charge. Age of 6-11.99: USD 10 (Per kid/Per night on BB excluding extra bed), USD 25 (Per kid/Per night on HB excluding extra bed), USD 38 (Per kid/Per night on FB excluding extra bed). Baby cot on request can be provided free of charge. (Up to one cot per room)
